description: POST /agents/{agent_id}/delegations/{delegation_id}/end (§5.3): reducing, no step-up. {} is valid. API-7 leniency (DEC-682 item 27): this schema is what a client should send; the server is lenient. No member is strict: an omitted, unknown, or unparsable `record` (or any other member) is dropped. The 202 lists every dropped member's JSON pointer in `dropped`.
